{{Quote|Here's the best reward you'll find in Mos Taike: my sister's specialty! Don't show it around, or everyone will want a slice.|Bren Kingal, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Eopie Cream Pie''' was a type of delicious, [[Color/Legends|beige]]-colored, round [[Pie/Legends|pie]] whose recipe was a closely guarded secret of the [[Kingal family]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] was the specialty of the [[Bren Kingal's sister|sister]] of [[Bren Kingal]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on<ref name="SWG" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tatooine">{{DB|location|tatooine|Tatooine}}</ref> of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The pie shared its name with the [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]],<ref name="SWG" /> a beast [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Tatooine.<ref name="db">{{DB|creature|eopie|eopie}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="SWG" /> of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Bren enlisted a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a local murderer named [[Trone Thanamiroc]]. Once the spacer brought back an [[AT-ST driver]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] as proof of Thanamiroc's termination, Kingal rewarded the spacer with an Eopie Cream Pie and thirty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; he warned the spacer, however, to keep it hidden, for otherwise everyone would want to partake in the dessert.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Eopie Cream Pie was created for the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it appeared as a consumable food item<ref name="SWG" /> prior to ''Galaxies''{{'}} closure in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the player could only acquire the pie after completing Bren Kingal's fourth player quest, which was to kill Trone Thanamiroc.<ref name="SWG" />
